donorReadme: - Source: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Space Science Institute Mimas Global Map - June 2017 (PIA17214)
- Purpose: replace the previous annotated map image with the clean unlabeled simple-cylindrical global map
- Projection: equidistant/simple cylindrical, `5760x2880`, 16 pixels per degree

coordinates.placement: latLonToXYZ in the donor src/entities/hotspot.ts, on Three.js SphereGeometry UVs
coordinates.longitudeDegrees: exactly as stored in features.json, placed by latLonToXYZ whatever the range; the donor stores values already in its own marker frame (see longitudeRange, markerLongitudeFromSource and donorReadmeNote)
coordinates.position: [radius * sin(phi) * sin(theta), radius * cos(phi), radius * sin(phi) * cos(theta)]
coordinates.donorReadmeNote: - The current Mimas release uses the NASA/JPL/Cassini Imaging Team unlabeled global map at full `5760x2880` resolution. Source coordinate labels in `data/mimas-features.json` retain IAU positive-west values, while numeric marker longitudes use the app's east-positive convention: `markerLongitude = -westLongitude`, normalized to `[-180, 180]`.
